overclaims: Those explanations weaken the inference that leasing necessarily signals weak demand or displaces new hardware purchases.
checks.note: Excerpt and conditions are fine, and causal/unresolved/not_applicable matches the reviews. The rationale calls them 'the June deals', but e1 dates the Anthropic deal to May 6. The claim that the explanations weaken the displacement inference goes beyond e2, whose own note says it cannot show whether purchases were displaced. Google's 'bridge capacity' fits renting instead of buying. The e3 excerpt 'along with Nebius and Iren.' leaves out 'fallen further', so it doesn't show the fact it is cited for.
